look_here_first: Inspect the resinous head, stem surface, and mature cypsela: yellow rays around a disk, serrate leaves clasping the stem, glabrous-to-nearly-glabrous gland-dotted stems, and a pappus with numerous bristles. Do not identify from yellow color alone.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Annual herb with branching flowering stems; inspect base and mature shoots.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Alternate, toothed, sessile-to-clasping leaves; resin dots often visible.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Radiate yellow heads with sticky involucral phyllaries.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Stems largely glabrous apart from resin glands; compare hairiness directly.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Mature fruit with multiple pappus bristles; magnification useful.
